independent_source_translation.english: What do you say, wise one? Which occupation seems to you to be more important among these?

I tell you, it seems to me that the service of God holds first place among these occupations, just as it is read in the Gospel: First seek the kingdom of God and his righteousness, and all these things will be added to you.
And which among worldly occupations seems to you to hold first place?
Agriculture, because the ploughman feeds us all.
